name: firewallintentconverter
description: Browser-based multi-vendor firewall configuration converter for Juniper SRX

scripts.build:standalone: vite build --config vite.standalone.config.js && sed 's|\.\./assets/|./assets/|g' dist-standalone/standalone/index.html > dist-standalone/index.html && rm -rf dist-standalone/standalone && cp standalone/README.txt dist-standalone/
scripts.zip:standalone: npm run build:standalone && cd dist-standalone && zip -r ../firewallintentconverter-standalone.zip . -x 'prompts/*' && cd ..
scripts.test: vitest run && for f in tests/*.test.js; do grep -q "from 'vitest'" "$f" || node "$f"; done
